clips.title: The story
paras: On Ashenvale's western shore, Zoram'gar Outpost gives the Horde access to the Veiled Sea. The fortified beachhead watches the Zoram Strand and the threats rising from its waters and nearby depths.

Zoram'gar Outpost holds the northwestern edge of Ashenvale, where the forest meets the sea. Night elf territory lies inland, and hazards wait offshore. Scouts, hunters, and shaman at the isolated camp track local dangers. Life there is an endless vigil: naga prowl the shallows, while cultists and primal horrors stir in Blackfathom Deeps, the subterranean cavern system down the shore.

Zoram'gar Outpost keeps flight connections to other Horde holdings: Splintertree Post, the Crossroads, and Thunder Bluff. Though small, the camp anchors Horde supply lines on Ashenvale's western coast.
